criteria.requirement: Explain how the 10-second request changes the existing 60-second grace period.
criteria.claim: The effective grace period is shortened from 60 seconds to 10 seconds.
criteria.pass_condition: States that the smaller 10-second override is accepted.
criteria.fail_condition: Claims the 10-second request is ignored or leaves the value at 60 seconds.

criteria.requirement: Explain the pod-worker state update when the grace period is shortened.
criteria.claim: UpdatePod stores the shortened value, updates the termination override, and calls cancelFn.
criteria.fail_condition: Omits the state update or cancellation branch.

criteria.requirement: Explain what happens to the already-running termination operation.
criteria.claim: SyncTerminatingPod replaces the pod-worker context with context.TODO(), so cancellation does not propagate to the running termination operation.
criteria.pass_condition: Explains the context replacement and its effect on cancellation.
criteria.fail_condition: Claims cancelFn necessarily interrupts the already-running runtime termination.

criteria.requirement: Distinguish the stored 10-second grace value from the already-running runtime termination operation and trace the successful completion path.
criteria.claim: The stored grace value can become 10, but the already-running termination operation retains its original 60-second runtime argument; after successful termination, cleanup proceeds without another runtime termination call.
criteria.pass_condition: Correctly distinguishes the stored 10-second value from the in-progress 60-second runtime operation, explains successful completion and cleanup without another runtime termination call, and does not conflate this with an error/retry path.
criteria.fail_condition: Claims that the already-running 60-second runtime termination is changed in place to 10 seconds, or that successful completion necessarily causes another runtime termination call.

criteria.requirement: Explain the role of terminatingAt and elapsed time.
criteria.claim: terminatingAt records when termination began, but elapsed time is not subtracted from the new 10-second value.
criteria.pass_condition: States that the new value is not calculated as 10 seconds minus elapsed time.
criteria.fail_condition: Claims kubelet subtracts elapsed termination time from the new grace period.

criteria.claim: The flow is UpdatePod to calculateEffectiveGracePeriod to cancelFn to SyncTerminatingPod to killPod to the container runtime.
criteria.pass_condition: Provides the end-to-end flow and distinguishes the pending update from the already-running operation.
criteria.fail_condition: Provides only the final 10-second value without the relevant state and control-flow explanation.
